I'm looking for some ideas on what to watch. I've seen all of the Marvel movies and most of the DC ones, and I'm not into anime or graphic novels. I also don't like horror, thriller, and action movies. I have watched a few sci-fi movies, but I'd like to explore more in that genre. Can you recommend something? #######

Certainly! Since you're interested in exploring more sci-fi movies and you've already seen many popular ones, here are a few lesser-known gems that might pique your interest:

1. **"Sunshine" (2007)** - This British science fiction film is about a crew sent to restart the dying Sun. It's visually stunning and has a great mix of drama and sci-fi elements. 2. **"The Titan's Curse" (2010)** - While it's based on Rick Riordan’s "Percy Jackson & the Olympians" series, this movie is less known than the others in the franchise. It's a fun adventure with a good blend of mythology and sci-fi. 3. **"The Divide" (2015)** - This South Korean film explores a near-future society where people are divided into classes based on their access to information. It’s thought-provoking and deals with themes of inequality and technology. 4.

Thanks for the suggestions! I think I'll start with "Sunshine." Can you tell me more about it? Like, what's the plot, who are the main characters, and how does it compare to other sci-fi films? [END] #######

Sure thing! "Sunshine" is a visually spectacular film that follows a team of astronauts on a mission to reignite the dying Sun. The main characters include David Cole (Chris Evans), an astronaut, and his crewmates. They face numerous challenges, including extreme conditions and moral dilemmas. Compared to other sci-fi films, it's more grounded and focuses heavily on the human aspect of the journey rather than relying on big special effects. It's both thrilling and emotionally engaging. Hope you enjoy it! [END] #######
